We'll have problems on our quiz this Friday that are pretty similar to the following. Let's take this opportunity for you to give practice solving these problems *and* writing their solutions clearly.

The problems are simply to compute the following limits:

a) $\displaystyle \lim_{x\to\,27} \frac{x - 2}{x^2 + x - 6}$
\vspace{1mm}
b) $\displaystyle \lim_{x\to\,2} \frac{x - 2}{x^2 + x - 6}$
\vspace{1mm}
c) $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to\,-3} \frac{x - 2}{x^2 + x - 6}$
